fields.label: Applicant e-ID
fields.description: The e-ID this case is ABOUT. Row scoping keys on this, never on owner.

fields.label: Facilitator e-ID
fields.description: Set only when a Regional Facilitator was mandated to act for this applicant. The owner stays the applicant.

Draft

Verification Pending
Approved
Declined

Disbursed

fields.description: Business state. Only services/ may change it, and only along domain/statuses.TRANSITIONS.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Optimistic concurrency counter for draft autosave (If-Match). Incremented on every accepted write.

fields.options: Business, financial and purpose fields are added here as each Phase 2 wizard step is implemented. The persona, scoping and lifecycle fields above are the stable core.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The lending product this request is against.

fields.label: Requested Amount
fields.description: What the applicant asked for. Checked against the active product ceiling at submit.

fields.label: Purpose of Funds
fields.description: The one line the applicant's dashboard card shows.

fields.label: Approved Amount
fields.description: The Underwriter types the decided amount here. May be LOWER than requested, never higher (features.md) - a value rule, enforced in the service and in the controller's validate(), NOT by locking the field.

fields.label: Decision Reason
fields.description: The Underwriter writes the reason here. Required on decline - features.md: 'cannot be left blank'. Enforced in validate(), not by a field lock.
